title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Solo #09 (대각 띠 3구역·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Pakistani woman, an adult, in her early 20s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, and continuing that same broad, continuous, solid silhouette, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward from her thick sturdy torso with no sharp transition anywhere, enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in high ponytail, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with diamonds in gold-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold a ring. Full body painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 49% of the way down her figure from the top and about 75% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), wide ochre bands following the contours of the body, with spiral floral bands filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
